name: What is the typical timeline for completing a room addition project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for completing a room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition project can range from a few months to over half a year, depending on its scope and complexity. A small, straightforward addition might take 3-5 months, including design, permitting, and construction. Larger or more complex projects, such as a second-story addition or extensive structural changes, could take 6-12 months or more. We'll provide a more precise project schedule after finalizing the design and obtaining all necessary permits.
